definitions: Plural form of staff, meaning a stick or rod.
Plural form of staff, meaning a group of people working together.
Plural form of staff, meaning a set of five parallel horizontal lines on which musical notation is written.
Plural form of stave, meaning one of the the curved strips of wood that form the sides of a barrel or tub.
Plural form of stave, meaning a verse or stanza of a song or poem.
examples: The old man leaned on his staves.
The composer wrote the melody across several staves.
The cooper replaced the broken staves of the barrel.
